request.prompt: Use case: sketch-to-render. STRICT TEXTURE-ONLY EDIT of this exact low-poly courtyard blockout. This is an orthographic 2:1 dimetric 45 yaw 30 elevation MAP BUILDING. Keep the image framing, exact outer footprint silhouette and all three visible ground vertices at their CURRENT pixel coordinates. Do not change the camera. Ground axes must stay EXACTLY slope +0.500 and -0.500. EVERY wall, ground paving line and roof ridge remains parallel to its blockout direction. Do NOT shift any outer corner, widen/deepen the compound, or add any ground/apron outside existing polygon. Preserve verticals. Yuan northern princely compound, grand central single-story gray tiled hall, vermilion columns and restrained dark teal beam painting, modest hipped-gable roof, broad bare gray paved court. footprint 20 by 16. All warm tan faces become realistic finely weathered buff earth plaster with sparse gray brick base, dark gray faces become realistically detailed small gray fired-clay Yuan Chinese roof tiles, gently curved eaves, plain ridge tiles. Add fine brown timber doors, posts and window lattice to the existing geometry. Restrained historic realism matching detailed gray tile timber Chinese city game sprites, not cartoon, no flat vector faces. Main light upper left, minute lower right contact shadow contained within original footprint. Empty areas MUST be true fully transparent alpha zero, no backdrop or glow; opaque building surfaces. No text, symbols, signage, banner, humans, modern elements, painted axes or grid overlays. ONE complete isolated building, use source canvas shape and margins.

geometry_qa.precision_note: 独立读源图可见墙脚左/前/右角，±3px；锚取左右角中点；另拟合连续可见墙脚检验局部平行性。

steps: uniform LANCZOS resize; round dimensions to pixels
paste without mask into transparent canvas; no warp/repaint/flip/alpha threshold

notes: 第三次运行：两候选均实际生成并归档，选v02仅简模纹理编辑；相较旧图统一双轴，但局部墙脚拟合仍有超出±0.5±0.03，未完成严格几何验收，保留candidate。仅裁切、等比缩放、透明扩边；保留本轮失败记录。
